incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A multi-storey building is partially collapsed, with debris scattered across the street. Adjacent structures and a tree are visible in the background.

observations.description: A multi-storey building is visibly collapsed, with exposed interiors and rubble. Adjacent structures appear intact.
A street pole is standing, and some utility wires are visible in the sky.
A green tree is visible in the background, behind the debris.
Some wooden planks and metal sheets are visible among the rubble.

inconsistencies: Report mentions 'five-storey' building — image shows only partial structure, possibly not the full five storeys.
not_determinable: Presence of people inside the building
Scale of collapse or distance from viewer
